_source: HEDB Data Dictionary 202601, sheet 'Employee Workload ' (note the trailing space in the sheet name)
_note: New 2026-10-28, built against Zoho_To_CHEDS_ (34).ds. HEDB 202601 removes four fields on this sheet (Load_Full_Part_Time, Load_Credits_Delivered, Load_Total_Credited_Students, Load_Total_Non_Credited_Students -- all filled red) and the .ds carries the same note on Employee_Workload_Function; none of them appear here. raw_column values are the dictionary's 'Database Field Name' column verbatim, including the ALL-CAPS LOAD_EXCH_INST_CODE and the trailing spaces on Load_Institution_name and Load_Program_codes. Zoho stores the DISPLAY text for every dropdown; the push converts each back with a Dropdown_Fields function or .Code.

fields._note: Raw HEDB code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Institutional Codes' reference list -- this lookup displays [Name]. NOTE: unlike most forms in this app, the list here is NOT filtered to Code == "141", so any institution can be picked; the push hardcodes institutionCode = 141 regardless.
Reference only -- the Zoho form derives the name from the institution code lookup. NOTE: this CHEDS header has a TRAILING SPACE.

Raw HEDB code is converted to a combined 'Name - Code' display value using the 'Academic Period' reference list, because this lookup displays [Name + " - " + Code]. The push sends rec.Academic_Period.Code.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.

Raw CHEDS level code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Degree or Program Level' reference list; this lookup displays [Name] and the push sends rec.Program_Level.Code. WARNING: the Zoho picklist is filtered to Code == "BA" || Code == "MB", so ONLY Bachelors and MBA can be selected -- every other level CHEDS allows (Masters, Doctorate, Diploma, Foundation, ...) will fail to resolve. CHEDS also defines two special values with no entry in this list at all: 'GE' for faculty teaching mainly General Education/Math/basic science, and '99' for research-only or career-support staff. Widen the filter and add GE/99 options before importing anything other than BA/MB.

Raw CIP Family code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Area of Specialization' reference list; the push sends .Code back. CHEDS says to leave this blank for research-only or career-support staff.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.

value_map.A: Full-time Instructional Faculty: Faculty employed on a full-time basis for instruction
value_map.B: Part-time Instructional Faculty: Adjuncts and other instructors being paid solely for part-time
value_map.C: Instructional faculty in preclinical and clinical medicine, faculty who are not paid
value_map.D: Administrative officers with titles such as VP, dean of students, librarian, registrar
value_map.E: Undergraduate or graduate students who assist in the instruction of courses
value_map.F: Faculty on sabbatical or leave with or without pay
value_map.G: Replacement faculty for faculty on sabbatical leave or leave with pay
value_map.H: Full-time or Part-time faculty based on a campus outside of the UAE,
value_map.R: Staff particularly hired for conducting research (Research Assistants) , OR Staff on admin contracts
value_map.P: Staff partially responsible for research. Add the position held by the staff in the column 'Admin
value_map.I: Career Advisors: Staff who are particularly dedicated towards career advising.
value_map.J: Staff who are partially working on advising students on career , entrepreneurship

fields._note: Raw employee-category code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text using a 12-entry table built from the 'Faculty Category' list (A..H, R, P, I, J). The Zoho choices are shortened versions of the dictionary's descriptions -- the text here is the live picklist's, which is what the import needs. The push converts it back via Dropdown_Fields.Employee_Category(). CHEDS test case: if EXCH_IN_OUT is filled then this must be 'H', and vice versa.

value_map.SRS: Senior Researcher (post held at Associate Professor level)
value_map.SRA: Senior Research Adviser (assistant professor or above)

fields._note: Raw Staff Position code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text. WARNING (1): this form merges 'Instructor' (INS) and 'Lecturer' (LEC) into ONE choice, 'Instructor/Lecturer', so the two codes cannot be told apart -- both are mapped to it here, and Employee - Basic Details keeps them separate, so the same raw code produces different text on the two forms. WARNING (2): HEDB 202601 ADDS two position codes, 'ADJ' (Adjunct Faculty) and 'PTP' (Part-time Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor) -- both are marked green/new on the Staff Position tab and NEITHER exists on this form, so a row using them is flagged and left as-is. Add both choices to Employee_position (and to Employee - Basic Details' Position_Title) before submitting. Also note Dropdown_Fields.Position_Title() is shared with Employee - Basic Details, whose choice list differs here, so confirm it still resolves 'Instructor/Lecturer' on the push.
No conversion -- open text. CHEDS asks for the position held here when Employee Category is 'P' (staff partially responsible for research).
No conversion -- credit-hour value, number with up to two decimals.
No conversion -- credit-hour value, number with up to two decimals.

No conversion -- credit-hour value. CHEDS calls this 'Admin Workload (report Career Advising and related fields)'; the Zoho field is Admin_Workload1 and the push key is adminWorkloadCareerAdvisingAndRelatedFields.
No conversion -- credit-hour value. Other admin workload EXCLUDING career advisory and the related fields already reported in Admin Workload, to avoid double counting.
No conversion -- credit (or contact) hours out of the total maximum workload, including both credit and non-credit courses.

Pass-through with validation: the Zoho picklist stores the CHEDS code itself ('IN' / 'OT'), so an identity value_map is used rather than kind 'plain' so anything else is flagged in the Report. The push sends rec.EXCH_IN_OUT unchanged.

Raw CHEDS University Code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Universities' reference list; this lookup displays [Name] and the push sends .Code. NOTE: CHEDS writes this header in ALL CAPS ('LOAD_EXCH_INST_CODE') while every other column on the sheet is 'Load_...' -- it must match character-for-character. Required whenever EXCH_IN_OUT is filled.
No conversion. Required whenever EXCH_IN_OUT is filled.

Raw 2-letter nation code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Country' reference list; the push sends .Code. NOTE: the Zoho field name misspells 'Institution' as 'Instituion' -- that is the live link name, not a typo here. Required whenever EXCH_IN_OUT is filled.
No conversion -- whole number. CHEDS: cannot be blank when teaching workload is not 0.
No conversion -- whole number. CHEDS: cannot be blank when teaching workload is not 0. NOTE the header is singular ('Course'), while the Zoho field is 'Total_Non_Credited_Course_Sections'.
Date-time values are trimmed to a plain date (time portion removed) and written as yyyy-mm-dd; the push re-formats with .toString("yyyy-MM-dd").
No conversion -- program codes from the Program Master, carried through as text. NOTE: this CHEDS header has a TRAILING SPACE. WARNING: the push does NOT currently send this field.
No conversion -- whole number. WARNING: the push does NOT currently send this field.
No conversion -- number with two decimal places. WARNING: the push does NOT currently send this field.
Reference only -- CHEDS says to send Last Updated ONLY through the master API. The form also has its own Last_Updated date field plus a lastUpdated datetime stamped by the push.
